name: Streakr - Settlement Notify
notes: Trigger: Cloud Function `notifySettlement` (backend/functions/src/n8n.ts) POSTs the SettlementNotifyPayload here on every call settlement. Set N8N_SETTLEMENT_WEBHOOK_URL in the Firebase Functions config/env to this webhook's production URL. `telegramChatId` should be resolved from Streakr's Room -> Telegram chat mapping upstream (e.g. a Firestore lookup node) if rooms map 1:1 to distinct Telegram groups; this version falls back to one shared demo chat via STREAKR_DEFAULT_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID for the hackathon demo.
